sportingGroups.title: Sporting groups
sportingGroups.description: Stable sporting classifications used to organize athletes and their training.
sportingGroups.emptyTitle: There are no sporting groups yet
sportingGroups.emptyDescription: Create the first sporting group to organize athletes and enable their planning workflows.
sportingGroups.newDescription: Create a stable sporting classification by combining training category and level.
sportingGroups.noMembers: This sporting group does not have any assigned athletes yet.
sportingGroups.membersSummary: {total} {total, plural, one {assigned athlete} other {assigned athletes}} · {active} {active, plural, one {active} other {active}}
sportingGroups.editDescription: Update the sporting group's description or operational status.

planningSubgroups.title: Planning subgroups
planningSubgroups.description: Temporary audiences of athletes from the same sporting group who share a planning objective.
planningSubgroups.emptyTitle: There are no planning subgroups yet
planningSubgroups.emptyDescription: Planning subgroups will appear here when the Coach creates a temporary audience with shared planning.
planningSubgroups.relationshipHelp: A planning subgroup is temporary and does not change the athlete's stable sporting group.
planningSubgroups.newDescription: Create a temporary audience for athletes from the same sporting group who share an objective and planning.
planningSubgroups.variantDescription: Shared plan for the current memberships in this planning subgroup.
planningSubgroups.noVariantDescription: This planning subgroup does not have an associated variant yet.
planningSubgroups.currentMembersEmpty: No athletes are following this planning today.
planningSubgroups.currentMembersCount: {count} {count, plural, one {athlete is} other {athletes are}} following this planning today.
planningSubgroups.upcomingMembersDescription: Athletes whose planning subgroup period has not started yet.
planningSubgroups.noMembershipHistory: There are no completed periods yet.
planningSubgroups.formSportingGroupHelp: The sporting group defines the planning subgroup's stable scope and cannot be changed.
planningSubgroups.noActiveSportingGroups: There are no active sporting groups available.
planningSubgroups.name: Name
planningSubgroups.sharedGoalPlaceholder: E.g. Prepare for a 12 km race with moderate elevation
planningSubgroups.archiveHelp: Archiving keeps history and prevents new changes or memberships. This action cannot be undone.
planningSubgroups.archivedHelp: This planning subgroup is archived. Its data remains available as history and cannot be edited.
planningSubgroups.editDescription: Update its operational identity without changing the sporting group or its members.
planningSubgroups.assignPageDescription: Add a dated period to {name}. The athlete's sporting group does not change.
planningSubgroups.closePageDescription: Close the membership without deleting the period or changing the athlete's sporting group.
